events.body:
## Context

README links `SETUP.md`, `INTEGRATION.md` and `PROJECT_SUMMARY.md` (none exist), lists `fl_chart` (removed), documents `POST /api/activity` though the code posts to `/api/activity/batch`, mentions a "Fresh" backend five times and labels the tree `flutter_tracker/`.

## What to do

1. Remove or fix each reference and document `run.sh` and `demo.sh`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every file and endpoint mentioned exists

## How to test locally

```bash
Docs only.
```
